name: AWS MCP Server
description: A read-only Model Context Protocol server that exposes over 60 AWS tools across services like EC2, S3, and IAM for AI agent interaction. It features multi-region support, resource caching, and audit logging to provide secure, AI-ready access to AWS infrastructure data.

rawRecord.description: A read-only Model Context Protocol server that exposes over 60 AWS tools across services like EC2, S3, and IAM for AI agent interaction. It features multi-region support, resource caching, and audit logging to provide secure, AI-ready access to AWS infrastructure data.

AWS_REGION.description: The AWS region to connect to (e.g., us-east-1)

AWS_PROFILE.description: The AWS profile to use for credentials

MCP_AWS_DRY_RUN.description: Set to 'true' to return mock data instead of making real AWS calls

AWS_ENDPOINT_URL.description: Custom AWS endpoint URL, useful for services like LocalStack

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: AWS access key ID for authentication

MCP_AWS_AUDIT_LOG.description: Set to 'true' to enable logging of tool invocations

MCP_AWS_CACHE_TTL.description: Optional TTL (Time To Live) for the in-memory cache

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: AWS secret access key for authentication
